reading.decorates: the NEAR MISS is the attribute site; the ANSWERING count is the attribute that CARRIES AN ARGUMENT LIST (applies a callable) — a marker attribute carries none
reading.renders: the NEAR MISS is the template site; the ANSWERING count is a call whose callee NAMES A TYPE ARGUMENT (the C#-lane shape)
reading.mixes_in: the NEAR MISS is the base clause; the ANSWERING count is a clause COMPOSING SEVERAL bases into one chain (the `with` shape C++ does not have)
reading.part_of: the NEAR MISS is the include; the ANSWERING count is the quoted include (a fragment sharing the unit's scope) vs the angle-bracket include (a separate module's header)
